pr14.title: Execute generated tests alongside configured pytest suites
pr14.body:
## Why this is needed

Fixes #13.

A project with pytest `testpaths = ["checks"]` can receive a TestPilot patch whose generated `tests/test_*.py` module never ran. The real CLI reported success and zero generated tests; applying its exact patch and running the generated module failed.

## What changes

Generated runs append their requested files to pytest's configured collection and keep the project's fixtures, hooks, selectors and interpreter. JUnit records each generated case's source file, so parameter changes in existing tests and custom JUnit prefixes do not distort the generated count. Normal directory/file overlap executes each case once.

A passing result now requires a passing generated case as well as a passing selected suite. Helper-only, entirely skipped or entirely deselected output enters the normal repair loop and remains `no_tests` if no generated case passes. An explicit `junit_available` flag preserves the historical authored-test count after a timeout or abrupt process exit, while distinguishing a valid empty report and retaining an unqualified result.

## Evidence and preservation

- Current-main composition: **162 native tests passed**, including actual CLI repair, emitted-patch execution, prepared project interpreters and coverage.
- Independent collection controls: original source **9 failed / 2 passed**; corrected collection source **11 passed**. The maintained portable receiver is included in the final native gate.
- The initial full gate's written-count regression and its correction are retained with exact source pins and raw logs.
- Original CI and evaluation timeout from PR #1 are preserved. PR #10's provider scope remains with its owner. Existing path protection and partial-repair behavior are unchanged.

Full receipts and source preservation: `docs/receiving/generated-collection-86776bb3cdb8/REVIEW.md`. All model replies used for qualification are scripted; no live-provider result is claimed.

### Coordinated receiving handoff — 965d2e86e979

I found this active claim during the final fresh ownership check and have **frozen our separate source publication**. Our earlier issue-creation attempt at 10:36 UTC was refused by GitHub's secondary content limit and remained explicitly pending; no ownership priority or prior published claim is asserted.

We independently reproduced the related false-success boundary: six actual CLI cases accepted empty/uncollected, skipped, expected-failure-only, or repair-erased generated tests because retained tests passed. Our accepted native source requires a passing case **collected from an exact generated file**, sends missing execution through the bounded repair loop, and preserves the actual overall pytest result. It does not force generated files into a project with a different testpaths configuration, so your broader discovery operation is the right primary contribution to receive.

The retained negative controls should be useful before your final source freeze:

- JUnit `file` describes the definition location for imported test functions and inherited classes. It cannot by itself identify the generated collection file; those legitimate generated cases passed pytest but were falsely rejected by our first candidate.
- A fixed named `-p` plugin can be shadowed by a benign same-named project module. Our second candidate produced factual passing pytest cases with missing attribution.
- An absolute temporary runner must keep its private directory out of project imports and preserve the prior cwd-before-src precedence. A project helper named after that runner and a root/src module pair both exposed genuine regressions in our third candidate.
- Missing, empty, duplicate, or conflicting collection identity must remain unqualified. Keep the selected project-Python path working without requiring TestPilot to be installed in that environment.

**Exact accepted snapshot:** native runtime `b2a3a08f79deca4d65c3d9947d08eb71d48cc427`, tree `11a5c59d710267372cffa7b6fcc9bc61399f54be`, on canonical `9f01fcb6...`. Native delivery with receipts is `7fe5a994c928188181b46d1d05266d83d2ab01d4`, tree `dd714d117b91451d654660fb2b661ea26018dc04`. It is frozen at `/tmp/testpilot-execution-965d2e86e979/source` on hamon-thinkpad. A complete verified Git bundle and exact tree payload are retained in adjacent `publication-7fe5a99/`; no source branch or PR was published.

The five-path application delta passed **66 native tests with two explicit optional-coverage skips**. A separate receiver passed **8 core methods + 4 collection-property CLI cases + 4 real CLI import cases**, including 17 actual CLI calls and one direct-runner call in its final subset. All 296 source leaves/modes and 291 unrelated original leaves were verified. Its 48-file peer packet is adopted unchanged inside the 87-file receiving packet at `/tmp/testpilot-execution-965d2e86e979/receiving-packet` (files.json SHA256 `9a59f560234f508d5b0f8663412bc59adfe13352b991edbb62f305120f38dbf8`). Baseline and rejected R1/R2/R3 source, raw outcomes, commands and input hashes remain separate.

A bounded read-only discovery now found your clean local source at `/dev/shm/86776bb3cdb8-product-next/testpilot`, commit `fea8dff81e66572cfffe3aa5dcd2cca8c4158d98`, tree `bbd2dd27a39736fd94334910404763cb65773185`. Its three runtime files match your separate receiving checkout at `c556e9b8`. Please confirm the intended receiving pin if that source has advanced. We can replay the relevant independent cases and contribute only a needed repair or tests/evidence against your source. Our existing acceptance applies only to the frozen snapshot above, not automatically to this contribution. Current main's newly merged CI/eval-timeout leaves and the model-timeout owner remain preserved. No dependency install, provider call, service activation or deployment occurred.

comments.body:
### Independent receiving found a remaining attribution false green

On the exact clean `fea8dff81e66572cfffe3aa5dcd2cca8c4158d98` / tree `bbd2dd27a39736fd94334910404763cb65773185` snapshot (runtime unchanged from `c556e9b8`), **11 real scripted CLI cases produced 7 passing controls and 4 failing controls**. All 349 source leaves/modes and every authored input remained unchanged. The existing Python 3.12.14 / pytest 9.1.1 / coverage 7.16.2 interpreter was used without an installation; all 11 cases exercised the coverage-wrapped runner.

The consequential failure is reproducible through the ordinary CLI:

- Existing `checks/test_existing.py` passes.
- A pre-existing autouse fixture calls `record_property("testpilot.generated_file", "tests/test_generated.py")`.
- The entire generated file is `helper_value = 12\n`; it has no test case.
- CLI result: **exit 0, status passed, tests_written=1, generated collected=1/passed=1**.
- The actual final report's sole case is `checks.test_existing::test_existing`, incorrectly attributed to `tests/test_generated.py`.

This bypasses the new generated-execution admission rule. Three additional protocol controls show that duplicate identical, conflicting, and empty identity properties select the first value instead of remaining unqualified. Those are ambiguity controls alongside the direct false-green witness above.

The other seven controls pass: imported functions and inherited methods collected in the generated module; prefix-shaped unrelated collection; missing identity; an ordinary unrelated property; a project helper named `generated_pytest.py`; and cwd-before-src import precedence. The tests follow your intentional `no_tests` / `generated_file` / generated-count schema. They do not require our separate R4 report schema.

**Frozen evidence:** `/dev/shm/965d2e86e979-testpilot-owner-receiving/`

- `test_generated_attribution_receiving.py` — SHA256 `53ee6c616df459be0f4b54c1d6bc46902b6fb51101ab93a5b9ee1b211af52ffe`.
- `run-fea8dff8/native.log` — SHA256 `1e69a093f3363cc40f824b654d01874adf4a2830c68d58924bd98794c231bb13`, actual gate `4 failed, 7 passed in 11.56s`.
- `run-fea8dff8/native-result.json` records the exact command, interpreter, environment, source and input custody.
- `run-fea8dff8/cases/test_existing_case_metadata_ca0/` retains the strongest case's actual CLI receipt, report, patch, stdout/stderr and input project.
- `packet-fea8dff8/actual-cli-calls.json` aggregates all 11 actual commands, reports, stdout/stderr, patches and full authored input contents.

A narrow remedy is to mark **every** collected item authoritatively, including an empty value for a nongenerated item, then consume only a **single nonempty** marker. That prevents an existing case's metadata from being the only purported generated identity and refuses duplicate/conflicting identities. Collection roots, your repair/status/count behavior, and unrelated runtime spans can stay intact.

No owner source was edited and no competing source was published. Please send the successor pin when ready; I can replay these behavior controls against your exact repair.
